protected_study: Existing F17 manuscript, results and public release assets are read-only; protected_before.json defines the byte snapshot.
specialist_seed_pairs: All nine ordered pairs of the already available seeds 17,42,101; diagonal and off-diagonal summaries separate. Corresponding seed pair used in each initialization contrast.
specialist_length_weights: Equal 1/21, fixed before new calculations. No pooled length-residual statistic substituted for these values.
landmark: Final-layer final_norm at ONE_END before any task token. Reuse audited causal-prefix features; verify against prefix-only original forward.
input_pairings: Identity, correct transform from original eight relations, and original wrong transform (C for inverse relations; I for complement relations).
initial_identity_policy: Prefer saved initial/step-0 weights. Otherwise audit config, vocab, source history and seeding-to-factory RNG order. Program-rebuilt weights remain unverified as original initial weights even when cached reference features reproduce. No re-training.
sensitivity_scope: Reuse existing same-seed ordinary/input-adjusted values. No input-kernel, metric, length or task search. Conditional group residuals couple samples; U-centered CKA is a metric sensitivity, not a guarantee of unbiased conditional-population estimation.
permutation_calibration: Reuse original common-answer-stratum permutation procedure and 32 draws, seed 2026100702 plus fixed relation index; same orders for trained/init and correct/wrong, all source pairs. New per-length calibration, aggregated with 1/21. Empirical ranks are descriptive, not new confirmatory p values.
input_uncertainty: 256 coupled paired orbit-anchor bootstrap draws, fixed seed 2026100901, resampling within each fixed length for the ordinary raw primary. Same indices shared across relations, source pairs, trained/init and input transforms. Seeds remain fixed; no relation-population CI. Answer/input/debias controls retain per-length and seed ranges rather than claiming bootstrap coverage for fitted nuisance centers.
relation_summaries: All eight relations; same/cross-seed means, medians, seed ranges, per-length sign counts, leave-one-relation and leave-one-length sensitivity. Seeds do not multiply independent relation count. All relations share inputs and transform families; fixed effects are descriptive.
k_series: All available R0/R1/R2 and fixed-seed subset R3/R4, k=1,2,4,8,16, both pools. Reuse trained feature caches; reuse/reproduce seed17/42 references, extract only missing seed101 init. Verify reconstructed A/B parameters independently per model. Original starting-weight equality remains unverified without direct evidence.
k_length_weights: Equal 1/29 over every original length 2..30; pooled original 4096 input CKA is a separate control. Report low-length duplicate-input and geometric-ceiling limitations, not outcome-based exclusion.
k_uncertainty_scope: Report each pool split. R0/R3/R4 share initialization seed17 and are subset-sensitivity runs; do not pool five splits as independent seed/world replications.
ending_rule: Complete the listed audits, missing computations, verification and report, then stop. No new tasks, model seeds, training, rotated encodings, null-space or algebraic composition experiments. No updates to F17 files or releases.
